landing.name: Hero + Features + CTA
landing.order: Hero with headline/image > Value prop > Key features (3-5) > CTA section > Footer
landing.cta: Hero (sticky) + Bottom
landing.effects: Hero parallax, feature card hover lift, CTA glow on hover
landing.conversion: Deep CTA placement. For CTA label text, verify at least 4.5:1 against the button fill; use 7:1 only when the product explicitly targets AAA normal-text contrast. Keep focus and component boundaries independently…

landing.name: Hero + Testimonials + CTA
landing.order: Hero > Problem statement > Solution overview > Testimonials carousel > CTA
landing.cta: Hero (sticky) + Post-testimonials
landing.effects: Testimonial carousel slide animations, quote marks animations, avatar fade-in
landing.conversion: Social proof before CTA. Use a concise set of verified testimonials with photo, name, and role. CTA after social proof. Provide previous/next and pause controls; stop rotation on focus, hover, and reduced motion;…

landing.name: Product Demo + Features
landing.order: Hero > Product video/mockup (center) > Feature breakdown per section > Comparison (optional) > CTA
landing.cta: Video center + CTA right/bottom
landing.effects: Video play button pulse, feature scroll reveals, demo interaction highlights
landing.conversion: Use an interactive demo only when it explains value better than static media. Provide captions, transcript, visible play/pause controls, and a non-video fallback; do not autoplay under reduced motion. Pause media when…

landing.name: Minimal Single Column
landing.order: Hero headline > Short description > Benefit bullets (3 max) > CTA > Footer
landing.cta: Center, large CTA button
landing.effects: Minimal hover effects. Smooth scroll. CTA scale on hover (subtle)
landing.conversion: Single CTA focus. Large typography. Lots of whitespace. No nav clutter. Mobile-first.

landing.name: Funnel (3-Step Conversion)
landing.order: Hero > Step 1 (problem) > Step 2 (solution) > Step 3 (action) > CTA progression
landing.cta: Each step: mini-CTA. Final: main CTA
landing.effects: Step number animations, progress bar fill, step transitions smooth scroll
landing.conversion: Progressive disclosure. Show only essential info per step. Use progress indicators. Multiple CTAs.

landing.name: Comparison Table + CTA
landing.order: Hero > Problem intro > Comparison table (product vs competitors) > Pricing (optional) > CTA
landing.cta: Table: Right column. CTA: Below table
landing.effects: Table row hover highlight, price toggle animations, feature checkmark animations
landing.conversion: Use comparison to show unique value. Highlight your product row. Include 'free trial' in pricing row.

landing.name: Lead Magnet + Form
landing.order: Hero (benefit headline) > Lead magnet preview (ebook cover, checklist, etc) > Form (minimal fields) > CTA submit
landing.cta: Form CTA: Submit button
landing.effects: Form focus state animations, input validation animations, success confirmation animation
landing.conversion: Ask only for information necessary to deliver the lead magnet. Preview its value and show submission progress.

landing.name: Pricing Page + CTA
landing.order: Hero (pricing headline) > Price comparison cards > Feature comparison table > FAQ section > Final CTA
landing.cta: Each card: CTA button. Sticky CTA in nav
landing.effects: Price toggle animation (monthly/yearly), card comparison highlight, FAQ accordion open/close
landing.conversion: Highlight the plan that matches the intended audience and show actual annual savings transparently. Use FAQs to address concerns.

landing.name: Video-First Hero
landing.order: Hero with video background > Key features overlay > Benefits section > CTA
landing.cta: Overlay on video (center/bottom) + Bottom section
landing.effects: Video autoplay muted, parallax scroll, text fade-in on scroll
landing.conversion: Use video only when it demonstrates value better than static media. Add captions for accessibility. Compress video for performance. Provide captions and a visible pause control; use a static poster when reduced motion…

landing.name: Scroll-Triggered Storytelling
landing.order: Intro hook > Chapter 1 (problem) > Chapter 2 (journey) > Chapter 3 (solution) > Climax CTA
landing.cta: End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA
landing.effects: ScrollTrigger animations, parallax layers, progressive disclosure, chapter transitions
landing.conversion: Keep the narrative understandable without scroll-driven effects. Use progress indicator. Mobile: simplify animations. Keep DOM reading order complete; disable parallax and scroll-scrub under reduced motion. Pause scroll…

landing.name: AI Personalization Landing
landing.order: Dynamic hero (personalized) > Relevant features > Tailored testimonials > Smart CTA
landing.cta: Context-aware placement based on user segment
landing.effects: Dynamic content swap, fade transitions, personalized product recommendations
landing.conversion: Validate personalization with consent-aware product analytics. Requires analytics integration. Fallback for new users.

landing.name: Waitlist/Coming Soon
landing.order: Hero with countdown > Product teaser/preview > Email capture form > Social proof (waitlist count)
landing.cta: Email form prominent (above fold) + Sticky form on scroll
landing.effects: Countdown timer animation, email validation feedback, success confetti, social share buttons
landing.conversion: Explain early-access benefits without fabricated scarcity. Show a waitlist count only when it is current, verified, and dated. Provide a static launch deadline, pause decorative countdown motion when offscreen/hidden,…

landing.name: Comparison Table Focus
landing.order: Hero (problem statement) > Comparison matrix (you vs competitors) > Feature deep-dive > Winner CTA
landing.cta: After comparison table (highlighted row) + Bottom
landing.effects: Table row hover highlight, feature checkmark animations, sticky comparison header
landing.conversion: Show value vs competitors. Measure comparison performance with product-specific analytics. Be factual. Include pricing if favorable.

landing.name: Pricing-Focused Landing
